capabilities: Render a yearly heatmap for one habit per block
Compute current streak, longest streak and days done
Read true/false and numeric values from daily note properties
Open a day's daily note by clicking its cell
extras: Freemium: the free version covers a yearly heatmap and daily streak for one habit per block; Pro (US$12 one-time, no subscription) adds flexible streak rules, month/week/quarter/year-to-date views, several habits per block and PNG export. Pro is not sold in Japan. Only frontmatter properties are read, not task checkboxes in the note body.
problem: Daily notes already record habits as properties, but Obsidian gives no way to see them as a year-long heatmap or streak.

relations.evidence: Streakwise follows the folder and date format of the Periodic Notes plugin (daily notes) if enabled

summary: Habit heatmap and streak tracker that turns frontmatter properties in daily notes into a yearly heatmap with current and longest streaks.
